🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
ROTATION. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: VXX (1W: -5.20% | 1M: -10.44%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling (fear easing) and Semis/Tech strength — SOXX (1W: +5.67% | 1M: +21.84%) ABOVE TREND — support money rotating into growth rather than an outright risk-off.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Credit stress easing: HYG (1W: +0.57% | 1M: -0.05%) RECOVERY and LQD (1W: +0.47% | 1M: -0.66%) RECOVERY; HYG/LQD showing CREDIT STRESS ↓ falling. Fear declining: VXX (1W: -5.20% | 1M: -10.44%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling; Stocks vs Bonds flat/correcting: SPY/TLT signal CORRECTION.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral-to-tightening bias: Dollar Strength (1W: +0.25% | 1M: +1.06%) ABOVE TREND → flat and Yield Curve (1W: +1.32% | 1M: -1.73%) ↑ rising RECOVERY; TLT (1W: +1.22% | 1M: -1.80%) RECOVERY — duration divergence vs equities to watch.

📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Tech and semis leading: XLK (1W: +2.34% | 1M: +15.75%) ABOVE TREND and SOXX (1W: +5.67% | 1M: +21.84%) ABOVE TREND; Financials also positive: XLF (1W: +1.91% | 1M: +0.17%) ABOVE TREND. Style: Growth/Momentum showing strength.

5. US vs Global?
US outperforms: SPY (1W: +0.88% | 1M: +5.25%) ABOVE TREND; EM via EEM (1W: +1.24% | 1M: +5.66%) ABOVE TREND. China underperforms: FXI (1W: -1.88% | 1M: -2.66%) BELOW TREND.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Mixed but active: IWM (1W: +2.71% | 1M: +3.48%) ABOVE TREND and ARKK (1W: +2.00% | 1M: -0.13%) RECOVERY show retail/speculative interest while IBIT (1W: -4.15% | 1M: -2.47%) BELOW TREND signals crypto weakness.

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Reflation tone via metals/copper: CPER (1W: +2.05% | 1M: +5.30%) ABOVE TREND; Gold under pressure: GLD (1W: -0.83% | 1M: -3.99%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling.

8. Energy Trend?
Mixed energy: XLE (1W: +0.08% | 1M: +4.41%) ABOVE TREND → flat while Brent BNO (1W: -4.66% | 1M: +4.36%) CORRECTION and UNG (1W: -3.44% | 1M: +3.99%) CORRECTION show short-term commodity volatility.

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
CONFIRMED: Tech/semis breadth — XLK and SOXX both 1W/1M positive ABOVE TREND. DIVERGENCE: TLT RECOVERY (1W: +1.22% | 1M: -1.80%) vs equities ABOVE TREND is a minor duration divergence; commodity futures (BNO/UNG) are CORRECTION divergences to monitor.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor Growth/Momentum ETFs showing leadership (XLK (1W: +2.34% | 1M: +15.75%) ABOVE TREND, SOXX (1W: +5.67% | 1M: +21.84%) ABOVE TREND); reduce exposure to China/Materials pockets showing weakness (FXI (1W: -1.88% | 1M: -2.66%) BELOW TREND, XLB (1W: -0.02% | 1M: -2.93%) BELOW TREND). Bonds neutral-to-hedge given TLT RECOVERY.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: Tech/Semis — XLK (1W: +2.34% | 1M: +15.75%) ABOVE TREND, SOXX (1W: +5.67% | 1M: +21.84%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Materials/China — XLB (1W: -0.02% | 1M: -2.93%) BELOW TREND, FXI (1W: -1.88% | 1M: -2.66%) BELOW TREND.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: Copper/industrial reflation via CPER (1W: +2.05% | 1M: +5.30%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Oil and nat-gas short-term pullbacks — BNO (1W: -4.66% | 1M: +4.36%) CORRECTION, UNG (1W: -3.44% | 1M: +3.99%) CORRECTION.

13. Key Levels?
VXX ~26 (VXX (1W: -5.20% | 1M: -10.44%) BELOW TREND = complacency threshold), HYG/LQD ratio ~0.7374 (Credit spread health), XLK/XLF = 3.47 (Tech vs Financials pivot), SPY momentum tested by SPY (1W: +0.88% | 1M: +5.25%) ABOVE TREND.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive, VXX falling (1W: -5.20% | 1M: -10.44%) BELOW TREND and semis/tech strength (SOXX (1W: +5.67% | 1M: +21.84%) ABOVE TREND) confirm money is rotating into growth. Tech and momentum ETFs (XLK, SOXX, QQQ) showing relative strength while China/Materials (FXI, XLB) show weakness to monitor; TLT RECOVERY (1W: +1.22% | 1M: -1.80%) is the key divergence to watch.
